summary: Iteration 17: verified new rich-description + document-preview feature set end-to-end. Backend pytest (7/7 pass) covers revisions/maintenance listings including description_html, task PATCH description_html sanitization (strips <script>, keeps <b>, derives plain description), subtask PATCH description_html persistence, and subtask image upload/fetch. Frontend Playwright confirmed: Kanban task editor + toolbar + image input present; subtask rich editor saves (toast 'Deskripsi subtask disimpan'); revision card on /revisions navigates to /projects/{pid}/kanban?task={task_id} opening task-detail with HTML description rendered; maintenance-1 card does the same; ticket-sourced maintenance row is NOT clickable (no is-clickable class, click did not navigate); document preview opens for PDF (iframe), PNG (image), CSV (text) with correct testids; previewing a task attachment inside task-detail does NOT close the drawer and Escape closes only the preview.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/projects.py attach_task_info only copies description_html when task has it set (non-None). That is correct — maintenance rows without rich descriptions simply omit the field. Verified against seeded maintenance-1 (no html) and revision-1 (html present).
backend/kanban.py edit_subtask → drop_unused_subtask_images sanitizes HTML and recomputes plain description server-side; confirmed <script> stripped while <b>/<strong>/<em> preserved.
backend/task_media.py enforces MAX_IMAGES per subtask (400 if exceeded) — good guardrail, same as task description images.

frontend DocPreview mounts images/PDF/text/docx/xlsx branches by content-type with proper data-testids; close via Escape or close button leaves parent dialogs (task-detail drawer) intact — verified. Nice.
frontend WorkCard sets is-clickable only when onOpen is provided; ticket-sourced maintenance rows correctly skip it, preventing accidental navigation.
